title: Geometric stalks commute with colimits
statement:
Let $T$ be a scheme and $\bar t$ a geometric point of $T$. The
stalk functor $F\mapsto F_{\bar t}$ of
[def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] commutes with arbitrary colimits
of sheaves on $T_{\Et}$; consequently it commutes with colimits of
complexes of sheaves, computed termwise.

proof.text: Let $(F_i)_{i\in I}$ be a small diagram of abelian sheaves on $T_{\Et}$. Regard abelian groups as $\mathbf Z$-modules. In the presheaf functor category, arbitrary colimits are computed objectwise (the coprojections and the universal map are defined section by section, and naturality follows from the restriction maps). Thus the presheaf colimit is $U\mapsto\operatorname{colim}_{i\in I}F_i(U)$. By [lem-weil-pbc-site-r-module-presheaf-sheafification-exact], sheafification is a left adjoint and commutes with all colimits, so the colimit sheaf is the sheafification of this presheaf.

By [lem-weil-pbc-sheafification-geometric-stalk], taking the stalk at $\bar t$ does not change this sheafification. Using [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks], the stalk of the colimit is therefore $\varinjlim_{(U,\bar u)}\operatorname{colim}_{i\in I}F_i(U)$, where the first colimit ranges over pointed etale neighbourhoods of $\bar t$.

The displayed iterated colimit is canonically isomorphic to $\operatorname{colim}_{i\in I}\varinjlim_{(U,\bar u)}F_i(U)$: both satisfy the same cocone universal property, since a cocone from the product indexing data is equivalently a compatible family of cocones in either order. The latter expression is $\operatorname{colim}_{i\in I}(F_i)_{\bar t}$ by [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks]. Hence the stalk functor preserves arbitrary colimits. Applying this argument in each degree gives the asserted preservation of colimits of complexes computed termwise.

split_report.summary: Corrected the imported proof using existing nodes for sheafification colimits and invariance of stalks under sheafification. The proof computes the colimit sheaf from the objectwise presheaf colimit, removes sheafification inside the stalk, interchanges the two colimits by the cocone universal property, and applies the argument degreewise to complexes. No new nodes were needed.
